orOS

orOS and its single apps: notes, calendar, office, money, health, maps and more. Offline-first, no account, no ads, no tracking. Free and open source (MIT), free forever.

Currently it serves 36 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://koulaxizis.github.io/oros-fdroid/repo
